body_markdown:
**Partnership aimed to accelerate Tablet Command’s continued growth and mission to equip fire departments and emergency response agencies with modern incident management technology**


**San Francisco and Fort Worth, TX, and Walnut Creek, CA** – TPG, a leading global alternative asset management firm, today announced that The Rise Funds, TPG’s multi-sector global impact investing strategy, has signed a definitive agreement to make a significant investment in Tablet Command, a leading provider of incident management and response software for fire departments and emergency response agencies.


Founded in 2011 by Andy Bozzo and William Pigeon, Tablet Command provides real-time incident management software designed to help emergency response teams manage complex, time-sensitive operations. Its platform digitizes critical incident command workflows, including tactical command, unit tracking, personnel accountability, and post-incident reporting, helping fire departments and other agencies improve coordination, situational awareness, and operational effectiveness.


Today, the company serves more than 180 departments and agencies across the United States and Canada, including CAL FIRE, and supports approximately 28 of the largest U.S. fire departments. As fire departments respond to increasingly complex emergencies and large-scale natural disasters, including wildfires, Tablet Command provides purpose-built technology that enables incident commanders to more effectively coordinate personnel, resources, and information in real time that can ultimately save lives.


“Tablet Command has built a differentiated platform addressing a crucial need for fire departments and emergency response agencies as they navigate increasingly complex incidents,” said Akash Pradhan, Business Unit Partner for The Rise Funds. “As communities face growing risks from climate-driven natural disasters, Tablet Command is an indispensable solution in incident response and climate resilience."


“Tablet Command was built by first responders to solve the challenges they experience in the field,” said William Pigeon, CEO and Co-Founder of Tablet Command. “That firsthand perspective continues to shape the company we’ve built. We're excited about the opportunity to continue growing Tablet Command and advancing our product while staying true to our mission. With TPG supporting us in this next chapter, we're aligned on a shared goal of making an impact on the world.”


“We’ve come a long way since Will and I started Tablet Command, and we still see tremendous potential ahead,” said Andy Bozzo, Co-Founder of Tablet Command. “We’ve been fortunate to build an incredible team and earn the trust of fire departments and first responders across the country. With TPG’s experience and resources behind us, we’ll be able to invest further in our team, our technology, and the customers we serve as we continue to grow.”


The investment builds on The Rise Funds’ longstanding focus on climate adaptation and resilience, as well as TPG’s experience investing in vertical software and government technology. Tablet Command sits at the intersection of these themes, providing critical technology to public safety agencies and first responders.


The transaction is expected to close in Q4 2026, subject to customary closing conditions.


**About Tablet Command**


Tablet Command provides the industry-leading Mobile CAD, emergency incident response and management solution to almost 80,000 users and more than 1,600 public safety agencies across the United States and Canada, resulting in 30,000+ incidents managed by customers. Tablet Command software solutions enhance safety and operational efficiency for emergency responders on the ground by providing comprehensive, real-time information under a single pane of glass. Tablet Command also records operational data as a byproduct of the incident management process, allowing fire personnel to assess performance accurately post-incident. For more information, please visit[www.TabletCommand.com](https://www.globenewswire.com/Tracker?data=suCARC5MAeeH4m6V1XeqFHSKGcW2SGqaVEDoaIYO7LN_P28HG6-FsNJetsUF9rGqUEm3azAgxp_9_m_0CUnZ9W2-VoH3uICwwUS98j6My-s=) .


**About TPG**


TPG is a leading global alternative asset management firm, founded in San Francisco in 1992, with $327 billion of assets under management and investment and operational teams around the world. TPG invests across a broadly diversified set of strategies, including private equity, impact, credit, real estate, and market solutions, and our unique strategy is driven by collaboration, innovation, and inclusion. Our teams combine deep product and sector experience with broad capabilities and expertise to develop differentiated insights and add value for our fund investors, portfolio companies, management teams, and communities.


**About The Rise Funds**


The Rise Funds are a core pillar of TPG's global impact investing platform. Founded in 2016 by TPG in partnership with Bono and Jeff Skoll, The Rise Funds invest behind impact entrepreneurs and growth-stage, high-potential, mission-driven companies that are focused on building and scaling solutions to the world’s most complex challenges. The Rise Funds deliver capabilities and expertise across a wide variety of sectors and countries at scale, focusing on opportunities in climate and decarbonization, education, financial inclusion, healthcare, and impact technology.


TPG’s Impact Platform is the world’s largest of its kind, managing approximately $35 billion in assets across a family of funds that pursue non-concessionary returns and social and environmental impact at scale through growth equity, private equity, and infrastructure investing strategies.
